name: 9987-imageprefill-qwen25vl7b-1gpu
hardware: 1x H100 80GB HBM3, one node, no router and no external cache tier
parallelism: tp1, pp1, dp1. Single-GPU is part of the declaration and must not be raised.
architecture: Qwen2_5_VLForConditionalGeneration, bf16: a 7B dense language model behind a 32-layer vision tower.
load_profile: concurrent (closed loop), streams=256, warmup the first 10% and cooldown the last 10%, bounded at 1024 requests with a 1800 s safety cap.
workload: Single-turn chat, one 1120x700 random-noise JPEG per request and no text of its own, one output token. ~1020 prompt tokens, of which 1000 are vision; every image is byte-distinct.
purpose: An image-tagging service captioning single uploaded photos for 256 concurrent users on one GPU with a 7B vision model.
launch:
# One H100 serving a 7B vision-language model over the OpenAI chat endpoint, 256 requests in
# flight, each carrying one 1120x700 JPEG and generating a single token.
#
# Flat `key: value` only -- the reader DROPS nested blocks, and a dropped block means the engine
# runs without something this file declares. Environment variables cannot live here.

model-path: Qwen/Qwen2.5-VL-7B-Instruct

# tp1 is part of the declaration and must not be raised.
tp-size: 1
enable-multimodal: true
chat-template: qwen2-vl

mem-fraction-static: 0.70

chunked-prefill-size: 8192
max-prefill-tokens: 8192

cuda-graph-bs: 256
cuda-graph-max-bs: 256

disable-radix-cache: true
